# SO3: no `objective go`. Its marker (5300, 25470) is not the firing position; the client keeps the SO2 presence spot and the look steps read the targets live (b18 run 2: 10762 uu from the marker).
# Item 3 (b17, senior b): equip the Morita only when it is not the equipped slot (then wait for the next card050 or
# card057 row so the slot row is current), then one press of its slot key, the underslung toggle: always a Switch
# and a card141 row.

# Range (senior batch 1 item 3; run 5 rewrite). The targets pop up and down on a 3 s / 3 s cycle (host 'A' rows

# gate a shot: run 5 hit the cap at C_4. Per target, up to 16 polls until the host count row: a look 60 uu above the
# root (the look row carries the live z, 174 up, -276 down), LMB only when that z is 150 or more, else 0.4 s. `must`
# on the count row: the first target not killed ends the run.
